Mstar_source: config/malanga/lupus_TableA1_Mstar_Hof.csv (Malanga et al. 2026 Table A.1, 65 measured M*, bootstrap, plus the scatter below)
Mstar_range_rule: M* (after the scatter) outside Mstar_range_Msun is redrawn from Table A.1, with a new scatter (own random stream, disc order) until inside; discs whose first draw is inside keep it (flag_Mstar_redrawn = 0)
star_source: config/malanga/BHAC15_iso_0.5Myr_Hof.csv (BHAC15, 0.5 Myr isochrone, linear interpolation in log-log)

grid_rule.formula: r_min = max(min(0.1 au (R*/R*(1 Msun))^(12/7), 0.1 au), 0.03 au), exponent 12/7 = R* dependence of Konigl (1991) Eq. 1 (mu = B* R*^3); r_max = min(20 R0, 1000 au) (20 R0 since 2026-10-29, was 400 R0); nr from the config

psi_floor: psi_DW = max(alpha_DW / alpha_SS - 1, 0); floored discs: e_rad = 1, lambda = inf (no wind)
R0_rule: R0 < 0.03 au (the r_min floor) is clipped to 0.03 au (flag_R0_clipped); then r_min <= R0
R0_rmin_rule: a draw with R0 / r_min below R0_rmin_min is discarded; the disc gets a new star (table entry, scatter, range test) and a new z_R0 until it passes (flag_R0_rmin_redrawn); z_M0, z_alpha, t_age are kept, M0 and alpha follow Eq. 7 at the new M*
lambda_rule: Balogh et al. (2026) Eq. 16 with e_rad from relation D (xi from Malanga Eq. 6)
